decisions.reason: The accent's existing requirement to derive from the Hero V geometry already accommodates changes to that geometry; the source does not change the derivation rule or accent-specific constraints.
The closing V remains governed by its existing derivation from the Hero V; changing the Hero V's stance does not alter that relational rule or establish a new closing-V-specific value.
The source concerns the Hero V's width, presence, and proportions and does not modify the deferred E and L letterform requirements.
The source changes geometric stance rather than the deferred champagne material treatment or its role.
The source does not address spacing or change the deferred requirement that the full wordmark read as one unified mark.
A wider, more authoritative Hero V remains compatible with the unchanged hierarchy in which the closing V is smaller and subordinate; no new relative-prominence rule is stated.
The client provides design feedback on Hero V proportions but does not change the requirement to include explanatory rationale with each review round.
